test_title: PYST 17: SSC CGL - Reasoning (Held On : 20 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the dice that can be formed by folding the given sheet along the lines.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9025355e9286f9c629fb0e18e5ad823ad3107c79b5db22fefe437dd4ec9eb57e.png]
solution:
The faces that will be opposite to each other when the paper is folded to form a cube is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fca77dfcc1f73ad99873cbf216e250efeb798acefaa7a19e3201b3a4d550354c.png] 

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c8d0c2239a632eaac753d0f34cf9f59327e75a85cf91619444402c0d0ebd5986.png] → The dice cannot be formed as 2 and 1 the faces opposite to each other.
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/64bd547c86df81a87e756903609832906555f1cafb8a1de9f996c057e5907aad.png] → The dice cannot be formed as 5 and 3 the faces opposite to each other.
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/57746195536265a2b5792d975c0f1c7f6b0cd34a53c21f055d14d5135394bf28.png] → The dice can be formed.
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ce6366f3af311103216351bf9bfe09c2ac60d14e1fcf15892d97a0d80c926da3.png] → The dice cannot be formed as 2 and 1 the faces opposite to each other.

 

Hence, '**option 3**' is the correct answer.
